description.value: Bright Jenny Coffee is a specialty coffee roaster and café in Kelowna, BC, roasting their own beans and serving a full drink and food menu in a café environment they describe as warm, welcoming, and personality-driven. They offer mobile ordering so cyclists can skip the line and have drinks ready on arrival. In addition to the café, they ship coffee Canada-wide and offer wholesale, subscriptions, and gift cards.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is fully active, confirms Bright Jenny Coffee as a specialty coffee roaster and café in Kelowna, and matches the OSM phone number and URL exactly. The 'Mobile Ordering is Now Live' banner and 'order ahead, have your drink waiting when you roll in' copy confirm takeout capability. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, etc.) are mentioned anywhere in the website content, so those remain null.
concerns: No physical address present in OSM record; the website's Locations page did not yield a street address in the fetched content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, open specialty coffee café in Kelowna with a live website, mobile ordering, and confirmed contact details — a clear stop for touring cyclists.

wow_evidence: specialty coffee roaster and café roasting their own beans, ships coffee Canada-wide
